findings: Renderer.resource(string) hashes name then enqueues a renderer callback, fences/waits and returns opaque lightuserdata. Underlying map helper inserts/rehashes on missing keys; not suitable for guessed read-only schema probes.
MeshComponent.get_property ultimately returns empty variant for every property on proved native provider.
ShadingEnvironmentBlendComponent.get_property supports only priority/opacity hashes on proved provider; no camera/pass/depth fields.

RenderDataComponent.get_property supports existing hashed typed properties but provides no key/schema enumeration itself. Raw protected copies of its existing property block can enumerate present key hashes/types/values without guessed names.
Entity component references and Unit refs are separate ownership domains even where wrappers shift encoded Lua userdata by2; map via qualified UnitComponent before attributing a component to FPS rig.
No inspected callback proves an FPS-only camera/pass/depth projection domain.
bounded_read_only_plan: Qualify exact build/callback bytes, world and manager pointer/vtable before discovery; reuse real userdata and existing entity handles.
Start with current existing entity providers and finite instances. Never call create/destroy/set_property/resource-generator APIs.

For RenderData, qualified instance lookup must prove entity, instance ID, internal row and property block pointer. Validate count/capacity and16+20*n<=capacity; impose capture budgets, not guessed native limits.
Copy current block only and close world/manager/vtable/row/block-pointer/header identities. Reject changed owners or size; close copies are not same-evaluation proof.
Decode supported tags conservatively; require relative payload ranges inside captured capacity and bounded NUL terminators. Record unknown hashed keys and tags without assigning names.
Resolve key names only from authored assets/known exact strings whose canonical path hash matches. Mapping property strings can identify native shading profiles but do not prove FPS render ownership.
If relating to FPS, qualify EntityManager.alive and UnitComponent mapping to current FPS Unit object; do not fabricate entity userdata from Unit ref.

Optionally snapshot existing renderer resource-map hashes/pointers through protected reads after full map/thread qualification; do not use Renderer.resource on guessed names. Opaque pointers are not typed schemas.
